title: Corrected scope of SPAR and removed invalid score subtraction
detail: SPAR C1.1 already requests national and subnational legal analysis/mapping. Its aggregate score is not interchangeable with an obligation-level ordinal legal coding.

title: Replaced future designation speculation
detail: PAHO reports Mexico confirmation as of 15 July 2026; the specific Mexican institution and domestic act are not identified by that report.

title: Added enacted notification, coordination and reference provisions
detail: Final NOM 6.6.3–6.6.4, 8.1.4, 3.1.30 and selected section 5 rules added. The earlier audit linked the 2012 project; this correction cites the enacted 19 February 2013 NOM. Manual review remains open.

title: Corrected SINAVE statutory attribution
detail: Express establish/operate competence is Article 133(II); Article 134 lists communicable diseases. Added the correct provision and corrected the affected descriptions.

title: Withdrew no-match classification for IHR Article 40
detail: RLGS Article 7 is a relevant candidate; exceptions and fiscal references need comparison. This is not a complete-compliance finding.

title: Added aviation and maritime declaration provisions
detail: RLGS Articles 30–31 identify presenters, arrival triggers and IHR form references. Old absence claims withdrawn.

title: Separated units and suspended unsupported gap totals
detail: 18 indexed instruments include two archived entries: 16 active in the pilot index. Coverage is 45 selected IHR2005 obligation units. Mapping/provision counts are regenerated, not hard-coded. No two-complete-path or six-instrument claim is certified.

title: Separated documentary association from legal dependency
detail: Actor-instrument source references do not establish issuing power or actor-to-actor cooperation. All registry actors are retained, including DGE and unmatched historical records. Four separately sourced normative relationships are provided.

title: Preserved original coding without presenting it as validated measurement
detail: Original scores and fit/gap fields are retained in legacy fields and the baseline archive. Current numerical ratings and headline gap totals are withheld pending revalidation; no pending value is imputed to zero.

title: Expert legal assessment remains outstanding
detail: These changes repair documented errors and preserve review questions. They do not validate the entire corpus, administrative practice, state laws, manuals or successor competences.
